meta.description: Passes an attested [grype](https://github.com/anchore/grype) vulnerability report only when every match has a severity the verifier explicitly allowed. Each severity has its own boolean context value, all off by default, so the policy fails on any finding unless its severity was enabled.
meta.name: Allowed Grype Severities

disallowedCount.code: has(predicate.data.matches) ? size(predicate.data.matches.filter(m, !((m.vulnerability.severity.lowerAscii() == 'critical' && context.allowCritical) || (m.vulnerability.severity.lowerAscii() == 'high' && context.allowHigh) || (m.vulnerability.severity.lowerAscii() == 'medium' && context.allowMedium) || (m.vulnerability.severity.lowerAscii() == 'low' && context.allowLow) || (m.vulnerability.severity.lowerAscii() == 'negligible' && context.allowNegligible) || (m.vulnerability.severity.lowerAscii() == 'unknown' && context.allowUnknown)))) : 0

error.message: Attested grype report has {{ .Outputs.disallowedCount }} matches with a disallowed severity
error.guidance: Remediate the vulnerabilities or enable their severity level via the allow* policy context values

assessment.message: All attested grype matches have an allowed severity
